component_requirement_checks.name: pyro_positive_fee_accounting
component_requirement_checks.requirement: A positive gate fee ($1/kg paid to obtain feedstock) must reduce annual profit by mass in kg times $1.
component_requirement_checks.interpretation: Upstream --battery-fee CLI says negative means recycler is paid. This result checks the reverse paid-fee direction using its own convention.

component_requirement_checks.name: pyro_negative_gate_fee_income
component_requirement_checks.requirement: Negative gate fee -$2/kg should increase revenue/profit by $2/kg at unchanged throughput.
component_requirement_checks.interpretation: Verifies the supported positive-income side of the gate-fee handling.

component_requirement_checks.name: localized_hazard_control_and_pilot_yield
component_requirement_checks.requirement: Economics must incorporate site-specific safety/compliance costs and pilot recovery yields.
component_requirement_checks.actual: Original default parameters only; no field, regulator, or plant records provided.
component_requirement_checks.expected: Local project feedstock, compliance CAPEX/OPEX, verified yield and buyer prices.
component_requirement_checks.interpretation: The upstream model has parameters but no verified local inputs; a synthetic profit output cannot establish investment economics.

component_requirement_checks.name: threshold_selection
component_requirement_checks.requirement: Elevated water-level fractions above 0.5 are selected, without normal/missing/invalid stations.
component_requirement_checks.interpretation: Synthetic values exercise the upstream station normalization and risk filter; thresholds are not calibrated for real rivers.

component_requirement_checks.name: missing_level_handling
component_requirement_checks.requirement: Missing station levels return no risk fraction rather than a fabricated warning.

component_requirement_checks.name: nonfinite_sensor_level_is_excluded
component_requirement_checks.requirement: NaN water-level readings must not be returned as candidates for an operational highest-risk list.
component_requirement_checks.interpretation: Nonfinite measurements are invalid telemetry; passing them into risk sorting can mislead downstream processing.

component_requirement_checks.name: nonfinite_station_corrupts_top_one_ordering
component_requirement_checks.requirement: At input [low=0.2, invalid=NaN, high=1.6], top-one must select the high station, irrespective of telemetry insertion order.
component_requirement_checks.interpretation: Upstream Python float NaN breaks total ordering and can suppress a truly higher station. Synthetic fixture is a direct module test; it does not establish actual public-warning failures.

component_requirement_checks.name: local_warning_distribution_and_health_outcomes
component_requirement_checks.requirement: A forecast/threshold module must be paired with validated local alert delivery and downstream response.
component_requirement_checks.expected: Site-calibrated telemetry, uncertainty, actual recipient alerts, response timestamps and health outcomes.
component_requirement_checks.interpretation: No live station feed, dissemination authority or health endpoint was tested.
